<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Ladies and Gentlemen:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">This letter agreement is entered between Devon Energy Corporation (together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, the &#8220;Company&#8221;) and the undersigned (the &#8220;Participant&#8221;) in connection with that certain Performance Share Unit Award Agreement (the &#8220;Agreement&#8221;) dated _______________, _____ between the Company and the Participant.&nbsp;&nbsp;All capitalized terms used in this letter agreement shall have the same meaning ascribed to them in the Agreement unless specifically denoted otherwise.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;color:#auto;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_C133"></a><a name="_DV_X75"></a><a name="_DV_C134"></a><a name="_DV_C135"></a><a name="_DV_X77"></a><a name="_DV_C136"></a><a name="_DV_C137"></a><a name="_DV_X79"></a><a name="_DV_C138"></a><a name="_DV_C139"></a><a name="_DV_X81"></a><a name="_DV_C140"></a><a name="_DV_C141"></a><a name="_DV_X83"></a><a name="_DV_C142"></a><a name="_DV_X85"></a><a name="_DV_C143"></a><font style="text-decoration:none;"><a name="_DV_X75"></a><a name="_DV_C134"></a>The Participant acknowledges that, during<a name="_DV_C135"></a> the course of and in connection with <a name="_DV_X77"></a><a name="_DV_C136"></a>the</font><font style="border-bottom:double 2.5pt;"> </font><font style="text-decoration:none;"><a name="_DV_C137"></a>employment relationship <a name="_DV_X79"></a><a name="_DV_C138"></a>between the Participant and the Company, the Company provided and the Participant accepted access to<a name="_DV_C139"></a> the Company&#8217;s trade secrets and confidential and proprietary information, which <a name="_DV_X81"></a><a name="_DV_C140"></a>included<a name="_DV_C141"></a>, without limitation, information pertaining to the Company&#8217;s finances, oil and gas properties and prospects, compensation structures, business and litigation strategies and future business plans and other information or material that is of special and unique value to the Company and that the Company maintains as confidential and does not disclose to the general public<a name="_DV_X83"></a><a name="_DV_C142"></a>, <a name="_DV_X85"></a><a name="_DV_C143"></a>whether through its annual report and/or filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission or otherwise (the &#8220;Confidential Information&#8221;).</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;color:#auto;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_X87"></a><a name="_DV_C144"></a><a name="_DV_C145"></a><a name="_DV_X89"></a><a name="_DV_C146"></a><a name="_DV_C147"></a><a name="_DV_X91"></a><a name="_DV_C148"></a><a name="_DV_C149"></a><a name="_DV_X93"></a><a name="_DV_C150"></a><a name="_DV_X95"></a><a name="_DV_C151"></a><a name="_DV_C152"></a><a name="_DV_X97"></a><a name="_DV_C153"></a><a name="_DV_X99"></a><a name="_DV_C154"></a><a name="_DV_C155"></a><font style="text-decoration:none;"><a name="_DV_C145"></a>The Participant <a name="_DV_X89"></a><a name="_DV_C146"></a>acknowledges<a name="_DV_C147"></a> that his position with the Company<a name="_DV_X91"></a><a name="_DV_C148"></a> was<a name="_DV_C149"></a> one of trust and confidence because of the access to <a name="_DV_X93"></a><a name="_DV_C150"></a>the<a name="_DV_X95"></a><a name="_DV_C151"></a> Confidential Information, requiring the Participant&#8217;s best efforts and utmost diligence to protect and maintain the confidentiality of the Confidential Information.&nbsp;&nbsp;Unless required by the Company <a name="_DV_C152"></a>or with the Company&#8217;s express written consent, the Participant will not, <a name="_DV_X97"></a><a name="_DV_C153"></a>during the term of this letter agreement<a name="_DV_X99"></a><a name="_DV_C154"></a>, directly or indirectly, disclose to others or use for his own benefit or the benefit of another any of the <a name="_DV_C155"></a>Confidential Information, whether or not the Confidential Information is acquired, learned, attained or developed by the Participant alone or in conjunction with others.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Participant agrees that, due to his access to the Confidential Information, the Participant would inevitably use and/or disclose that Confidential Information in breach of his confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations if the Participant worked in certain capacities or engaged in certain activities for a period of time following his employment with the Company, specifically in a position that involves (i) responsibility and decision-making authority or input at the executive level regarding any subject or responsibility, (ii) decision-making responsibility or input at any management level in the Participant&#8217;s individual area of assignment with the Company, or (iii) responsibility and decision-making authority or input that otherwise allows the use of the Confidential Information (collectively referred to as the &#8220;Restricted Occupation&#8221;).&nbsp;&nbsp;Therefore, except with the prior written consent of the Company, during the term of this letter agreement, the Participant agrees not to be employed by, consult for or otherwise act on behalf of any person or entity in any capacity in which he would be involved, directly or indirectly, in a Restricted Occupation.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant acknowledges that this commitment is intended to protect the Confidential Information and is not intended to be applied or interpreted as a covenant against competition.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU12"></a><font style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Participant further agrees that during the term of this letter agreement, the Participant will not, directly or indirectly on behalf of a person or entity or otherwise, (i)&#160;solicit any of the established customers of the Company or attempt to induce any of the established customers of the Company to cease doing business with the Company, or (ii) solicit any of the employees of the Company to cease employment with the Company.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:8pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;text-indent:7.69%;">Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing in this letter agreement is intended to conflict with the Defend Trade Secrets Act or create liability for disclosures of trade secrets that are expressly allowed by that statute. In particular, under the Defend Trade Secrets Act, the Participant will not be held criminally or civilly liable under any federal or state trade secret law for the disclosure of a trade secret of the Company that is made (i) in confidence to a government official or to the Participant&#8217;s attorney solely for the purpose of reporting or investigating a suspected violation of law or (ii) in a complaint or other document that is filed under seal in a proceeding. In addition, if the Participant files a lawsuit for retaliation by the Company for reporting a suspected violation of law, the Participant may disclose the trade secret to the Participant&#8217;s attorney and use the trade secret information in the court proceeding if the Participant files any document containing the trade secret under seal and does not otherwise disclose the trade secret, except pursuant to court order. <p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Calibri;font-size:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;color:#0D0D0D;letter-spacing:-0.15pt;">DEVON ENERGY CORPORATION</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#0D0D0D;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:-0.15pt;font-size:11pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2017 LONG-TERM INCENTIVE PLAN</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#0D0D0D;font-family:Calibri;font-size:11pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">RESTRICTED STOCK AWARD AGREEMENT</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-family:Calibri;font-size:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">THIS RESTRICTED STOCK AWARD AGREEMENT (this &#8220;Award Agreement&#8221;) is entered into as of <font style="font-weight:bold;color:#17365D;">Grant Date </font>(the &#8220;Date of Grant&#8221;), by and between Devon Energy Corporation, a Delaware corporation (the &#8220;Company&#8221;), and <font style="font-weight:bold;color:#17365D;">Participant Name</font><font style="color:#17365D;"> </font>(the &#8220;Participant&#8221;).</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#0D0D0D;font-family:Calibri;font-size:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">W I T N E S S E T H:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-family:Calibri;font-size:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">WHEREAS, the Company has previously adopted the Devon Energy Corporation 2017 Long-Term Incentive Plan (the &#8220;Plan&#8221;); and</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-family:Calibri;font-size:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">WHEREAS, in connection with the Participant&#8217;s employment with the Company, the Company desires to award to the Participant <font style="font-weight:bold;color:#17365D;">Number of Shares Granted</font><font style="color:#17365D;"> </font>shares of the Company&#8217;s Common Stock under the Plan subject to the terms and conditions of this Award Agreement and the Plan; and</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-family:Calibri;font-size:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and the mutual promises and covenants herein contained, the Participant and the Company agree as follows:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">The Plan</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan, a copy of which is attached hereto, is hereby incorporated by reference herein and made a part hereof for all purposes, and when taken with this Award Agreement shall govern the rights of the Participant and the Company with respect to the Award.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Grant of Award</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company hereby grants to the Participant an award (the &#8220;Award&#8221;) of </font><font style="font-weight:bold;color:#17365D;font-family:Calibri;">Number of Shares Granted</font><font style="color:#17365D;font-family:Calibri;"> </font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">shares of the Company&#8217;s Common Stock (the &#8220;Restricted Stock&#8221;), on the terms and conditions set forth herein and in the Plan.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">3.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Terms of Award</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(a)<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Escrow of Shares</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;A certificate or book-entry registration representing the Restricted Stock shall be issued in the name of the Participant and shall be escrowed with the Secretary subject to removal of the restrictions placed thereon or forfeiture pursuant to the terms of this Award Agreement.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(b)<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Vesting</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.69%;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(i)<font style="margin-left:144pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">25% of the shares of the Restricted Stock are scheduled to vest on each of the first four anniversary dates of the Date of Grant (each, a &#8220;Vesting Date&#8221;).</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">Except as provided in this Section 3, if the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination has not occurred as of a Vesting Date, then the Participant shall be entitled, subject to the applicable provisions of the Plan and this Award Agreement having been satisfied, to receive, on or within a reasonable time after the applicable Vesting Date, the shares scheduled to vest as of the applicable Vesting Date.&nbsp;&nbsp;The portion of the Restricted Stock that has vested pursuant to the terms of this Award Agreement shall be deemed &#8220;Vested Stock.&#8221;</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.69%;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU3"></a><font style="color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)</font><font style="margin-left:144pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">The Participant shall forfeit the unvested portion of the Award (including the underlying Restricted Stock and Accrued Dividends) upon the occurrence of the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination unless the Award becomes vested under the circumstances described in paragraphs (iii), (iv), or (v) below.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.69%;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(iii)<font style="margin-left:144pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">If (A) the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination occurs under circumstances in which the Participant is entitled to a severance payment from the Company, a Subsidiary, or an Affiliated Entity under (1) the Participant&#8217;s employment agreement or severance agreement with the Company due to a termination of the Participant&#8217;s employment by the Company without &#8220;cause&#8221; or by the Participant for &#8220;good reason&#8221; in accordance with the Participant&#8217;s employment agreement or severance agreement or (2) the Devon Energy Corporation Severance Plan and (B) the Participant timely signs and returns to the Company a release of claims against the Company in a form prepared by the Company (the &#8220;Release&#8221;), the Restricted Stock shall become fully vested upon the date the Release becomes effective and the Restricted Stock shall be released within a reasonable time after the applicable Vesting Date.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the Participant fails to timely sign and return the Release to the Company or revokes the Release prior to the date the Release becomes effective, the unvested shares of Restricted Stock subject to this Award Agreement shall be forfeited.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.69%;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(iv)<font style="margin-left:144pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">The Restricted Stock shall become fully vested upon the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination if the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination occurs by reason of the Participant&#8217;s death.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Committee may, in its sole and absolute discretion, elect to vest all or a portion of the unvested Restricted Stock upon the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination if the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination occurs by reason of disability or upon other special circumstances (as determined by the Committee and permitted pursuant to the Plan).</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.69%;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(v)<font style="margin-left:144pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">If the Participant is Post-Retirement Vesting Eligible, the Participant shall, subject to the satisfaction of the conditions in Section 15, be eligible to vest in accordance with the Vesting Schedule above in Section 3(b), in the installments of the Restricted Stock that remain unvested on the Date of Termination. If (i) the Participant is Post-Retirement Vesting Eligible, (ii) the death of the Participant occurs following the Date of Termination, and (iii) no Non-Compliance Event has occurred prior to the date of the Participant&#8217;s death, then any installments of Restricted Stock that remain unvested on the date of the Participant&#8217;s death but in which the Participant was eligible to vest pursuant to this Section 3(b)(v) shall become fully vested upon the Participant&#8217;s death.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.69%;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(vi)<font style="margin-left:144pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">If (1) the Award is eligible for vesting under the circumstances described in paragraphs (iii) (other than in connection with a Change in Control Event) or (v) above, and (2) the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination occurs before the one-year anniversary of the Date of Grant, then, notwithstanding such provisions in paragraphs (iii) and (v) above, the number of shares of Restricted Stock that would have otherwise vested pursuant to such provisions will be pro-rated based on the number of days from the Date of Grant to the Date of Termination out of 365.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU4"></a>(c)<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Voting Rights and Dividends</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant shall have all of the voting rights attributable to the shares of Restricted Stock.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any dividends declared and paid by the Company with respect to shares of Restricted Stock (the &#8220;Accrued Dividends&#8221;) shall not be paid to the Participant until such Restricted Stock becomes Vested Stock.&nbsp;&nbsp;Accrued Dividends shall be held by the Company as a general obligation of the Company and paid to the Participant reasonably promptly following the time the </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Calibri;">underlying Restricted Stock becomes Vested Stock</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;"> </font><font style="color:#0D0D0D;font-family:Calibri;">(but in no event later than March 15 of the calendar year following the calendar year in which such vesting occurs)</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(d)<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Vested Stock - Removal of Restrictions</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;Upon Restricted Stock becoming Vested Stock, all restrictions shall be removed from the certificates or book-entry registrations and the Participant shall be provided a confirmation of the release of such Vested Stock, representing such Vested Stock free and clear of all restrictions, except for any applicable securities laws restrictions. Reasonably promptly thereafter </font><font style="font-family:Calibri;color:#000000;">(but in no event later than March&#160;15 of the calendar year following the calendar year in which such vesting occurs)</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">, the Participant shall receive a payment in the amount of all Accrued Dividends attributed to such Vested Stock without interest thereon.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">4.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Legend</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The shares of Restricted Stock covered by the Award shall be subject to the restrictions described in the following legend, which shall appear on any individual certificate or book-entry registration representing the Award:</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.69%;margin-right:7.69%;text-indent:0%;color:#0D0D0D;font-family:Calibri;font-size:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;THE SHARES OF STOCK EVIDENCED BY THIS CERTIFICATE OR BOOK-ENTRY REGISTRATION ARE SUBJECT TO AND ARE TRANSFERABLE ONLY IN ACCORDANCE WITH THAT CERTAIN AWARD AGREEMENT DATED <font style="font-weight:bold;color:#17365D;">Grant Date</font><font style="color:#17365D;"> </font>UNDER THE DEVON ENERGY CORPORATION 2017 LONG-TERM INCENTIVE PLAN.&nbsp;&nbsp;ANY ATTEMPTED TRANSFER OF THE SHARES OF STOCK EVIDENCED BY THIS CERTIFICATE OR BOOK-ENTRY REGISTRATION IN VIOLATION OF SUCH AWARD AGREEMENT SHALL BE NULL AND VOID AND WITHOUT EFFECT.&nbsp;&nbsp;A COPY OF THE AWARD AGREEMENT MAY BE OBTAINED FROM THE SECRETARY OF DEVON ENERGY CORPORATION.&#8221;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">5.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Delivery of Forfeited Shares</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant authorizes the Secretary to deliver to the Company any and all shares of Restricted Stock that are forfeited under the provisions of this Award Agreement.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">6.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Employment.</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">&nbsp;&nbsp;Nothing in the Plan or in this Award Agreement shall confer upon the Participant any right to continue in the employ of the Company or any of its Subsidiaries or Affiliated Entities, or interfere in any way with the right to terminate the Participant&#8217;s employment at any time.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">7.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Nontransferability of Award</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant shall not have the right to sell, assign, transfer, convey, dispose, pledge, hypothecate, burden, encumber or charge any Restricted Stock or any interest therein in any manner whatsoever.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Notices</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;All notices or other communications relating to the Plan and this Award Agreement as it relates to the Participant shall be in writing and shall be delivered electronically, personally or mailed (U.S. mail) by the Company to the Participant at the then current address as maintained by the Company or such other address as the Participant may advise the Company in writing.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">9.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Binding Effect and Governing Law</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;This Award Agreement shall be (i) binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties hereto and their respective heirs, successors and assigns except as may be limited by the Plan, and (ii) governed by and construed under the laws of the State of Delaware.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU5"></a>10.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Company Policies</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant agrees that the Award, and the right to receive and/or retain any Vested Stock or cash payments covered by this Award, will be subject to any applicable clawback or recoupment policies, share trading policies and other policies that may be implemented from </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Calibri;">time to time by the Company's Board of Directors, a duly authorized committee thereof or the Company, or as required by applicable law or any applicable securities exchange listings standards.&nbsp;&nbsp;By accepting this Award under the Plan, the Participant agrees and acknowledges that the Participant is obligated to cooperate with, and provide any and all assistance necessary to, the Company to recover or recoup any Award or amounts paid under the Plan subject to clawback pursuant to such policy, law or standard.&nbsp;&nbsp;Such cooperation and assistance shall include, but is not limited to, executing, completing and submitting any documentation necessary to recover or recoup any Award or amounts paid pursuant to this Award.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">11.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Withholding</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">. The Company and the Participant shall comply with all federal and state laws and regulations respecting the required withholding, deposit and payment of any income, employment or other taxes relating to the Award (including Accrued Dividends).&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company shall withhold the employer&#8217;s minimum statutory withholding based upon minimum statutory withholding rates for federal and state purposes, or as otherwise approved by the Committee, including payroll taxes that are applicable to such supplemental taxable income.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any payment of required withholding taxes by the Participant in the form of Common Stock shall not be permitted if it would result in an accounting charge to the Company with respect to such shares used to pay such taxes unless otherwise approved by the Committee.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">12.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Award Subject to Claims of Creditors</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant shall not have any interest in any particular assets of the Company, its parent, if applicable, or any Subsidiary or Affiliated Entity by reason of the right to earn an Award (including Accrued Dividends) under the Plan and this Award Agreement, and the Participant or any other person shall have only the rights of a general unsecured creditor of the Company, its parent, if applicable, or a Subsidiary or Affiliated Entity with respect to any rights under the Plan or this Award Agreement.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Captions</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The captions of specific provisions of this Award Agreement are for convenience and reference only, and in no way define, describe, extend or limit the scope of this Award Agreement or the intent of any provision hereof.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">14.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Counterparts</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;This Award Agreement may be executed in any number of identical counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original for all purposes, but all of which taken together shall form one agreement.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">15.<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Conditions to Post-Retirement Vesting</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;letter-spacing:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_X103"></a><a name="_DV_C108"></a><a name="_DV_C109"></a><a name="_DV_X127"></a><a name="_DV_C110"></a><a name="_DV_C111"></a><a name="_DV_X125"></a><a name="_DV_C112"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU6"></a><font style="text-decoration:none;">(a)</font><font style="text-decoration:none;margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;color:#000000;">Notice of and Conditions to Post-Retirement Vesting</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;">If the Participant is Post-Retirement Vesting Eligible, the Company shall, within a reasonable period of time prior to the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination, notify the Participant that the Participant has the right, pursuant to this Section 15(a), to continue to vest following the Date of Termination in any unvested installments of Restricted Stock (each such unvested installment, an &#8220;Installment&#8221;). The Participant shall have the right to vest in such Installments of Restricted Stock, provided that the Participant executes and delivers to the Company, with respect to each such Installment, the following documentation: (i) a non-disclosure letter agreement, in the form attached as Exhibit A (a &#8220;Non<a name="_DV_X103"></a><a name="_DV_C108"></a>&#8209;Disclosure Agreement&#8221;)<a name="_DV_C109"></a> <a name="_DV_X127"></a><a name="_DV_C110"></a>and (ii) a compliance certificate,<a name="_DV_C111"></a> in the form attached as Exhibit B<a name="_DV_X125"></a><a name="_DV_C112"></a> (a &#8220;Compliance Certificate&#8221;) indicating the Participant&#8217;s full compliance with the Non-Disclosure Agreement.&nbsp;&nbsp;For each such Installment, (x) a Non-Disclosure Agreement shall be provided to the Company no later than March 31 of the year that immediately precedes the scheduled Vesting Date of such Installment or, with respect to the first Installment that is scheduled to occur following the Date of Termination, on or before the Date of Termination, and (y) a </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#0D0D0D;letter-spacing:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;">Compliance Certificate shall be provided to the Company no later than </font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;">January 1 of the year in which the Vesting Date of such Installment is scheduled to occur.</font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;">&nbsp;&nbsp;By way of illustration, if the Vesting Date of an Installment is scheduled to occur on February 1, a Non-Disclosure Agreement for such Installment would need to be provided to the Company by no later than </font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;">March 31</font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;"> of the preceding year; </font><font style="font-style:italic;text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;">provided, however, that</font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;"> if such Installment is the first Installment scheduled to occur following the Date of Termination, a Non-Disclosure Agreement for such Installment would need to be provided </font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;">on or before the Da</font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;">te of Termination. </font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;">Further, under the foregoing illustration, a Compliance Certificate would be delivered by no later than </font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;">January</font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;"> 1</font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;"> of the year in which the Vesting Date of such Installment is scheduled to occur.</font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;"> Notwithstanding the foregoing and for the avoidance of doubt, at the Company&#8217;s election, the Participant may deliver a single Non-Disclosure Agreement and Compliance Certificate, as applicable, for each year to satisfy the Participant&#8217;s obligations under this Section and similar provisions in the Participant&#8217;s other equity award agreements with the Company.</font></p>

name="_DV_C122"></a>(b)<font style="margin-left:108pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:0pt;">Consequences of Failure to Satisfy Vesting not be entitled to vest in any unvested Installments that would vest from and after the</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;"><a name="_DV_C118"></a> date </font><font authorized to take any and all such actions as are necessary to cause such unvested Restricted Stock to not vest and to terminate. <a name="_DV_C120"></a> </font><font in, and cancellation of, any unvested </font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:0pt;">Installments then held by the Participant.</font></p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-right:7.69%;text-indent:7.69%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_C133"></a><a name="_DV_X75"></a><a name="_DV_C134"></a><a name="_DV_C135"></a><a name="_DV_X77"></a><a name="_DV_C136"></a><a name="_DV_C137"></a><a name="_DV_X79"></a><a name="_DV_C138"></a><a name="_DV_C139"></a><a name="_DV_X81"></a><a name="_DV_C140"></a><a name="_DV_C141"></a><a name="_DV_X83"></a><a name="_DV_C142"></a><a name="_DV_X85"></a><a name="_DV_C143"></a><font style="text-decoration:none;"><a name="_DV_X75"></a><a name="_DV_C134"></a>The Participant acknowledges that, during<a name="_DV_C135"></a> the course of and in connection with <a name="_DV_X77"></a><a name="_DV_C136"></a>the</font><font style="border-bottom:double 2.5pt;"> </font><font style="text-decoration:none;"><a name="_DV_C137"></a>employment relationship <a name="_DV_X79"></a><a name="_DV_C138"></a>between the Participant and the Company, the Company provided and the Participant accepted access to<a name="_DV_C139"></a> the Company&#8217;s trade secrets and confidential and proprietary information, which <a name="_DV_X81"></a><a name="_DV_C140"></a>included<a name="_DV_C141"></a>, without limitation, information pertaining to the Company&#8217;s finances, oil and gas properties and prospects, compensation structures, business and litigation strategies and future business plans and other information or material that is of special and unique value to the Company and that the Company maintains as confidential and does not disclose to the general public<a name="_DV_X83"></a><a name="_DV_C142"></a>, <a name="_DV_X85"></a><a name="_DV_C143"></a>whether through its annual report and/or filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission or otherwise (the &#8220;Confidential Information&#8221;).</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-right:7.69%;text-indent:7.69%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_X87"></a><a name="_DV_C144"></a><a name="_DV_C145"></a><a name="_DV_X89"></a><a name="_DV_C146"></a><a name="_DV_C147"></a><a name="_DV_X91"></a><a name="_DV_C148"></a><a name="_DV_C149"></a><a name="_DV_X93"></a><a name="_DV_C150"></a><a name="_DV_X95"></a><a name="_DV_C151"></a><a name="_DV_C152"></a><a name="_DV_X97"></a><a name="_DV_C153"></a><a name="_DV_X99"></a><a name="_DV_C154"></a><a name="_DV_C155"></a><font style="text-decoration:none;"><a name="_DV_C145"></a>The Participant <a name="_DV_X89"></a><a name="_DV_C146"></a>acknowledges<a name="_DV_C147"></a> that his position with the Company<a name="_DV_X91"></a><a name="_DV_C148"></a> was<a name="_DV_C149"></a> one of trust and confidence because of the access to <a name="_DV_X93"></a><a name="_DV_C150"></a>the<a name="_DV_X95"></a><a name="_DV_C151"></a> Confidential Information, requiring the Participant&#8217;s best efforts and utmost diligence to protect and maintain the confidentiality of the Confidential Information.&nbsp;&nbsp;Unless required by the Company <a name="_DV_C152"></a>or with the Company&#8217;s express written consent, the Participant will not, <a name="_DV_X97"></a><a name="_DV_C153"></a>during the term of this letter agreement<a name="_DV_X99"></a><a name="_DV_C154"></a>, directly or indirectly, disclose to others or use for his own benefit or the benefit of another any of the <a name="_DV_C155"></a>Confidential Information, whether or not the Confidential Information is acquired, learned, attained or developed by the Participant alone or in conjunction with others.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-right:7.69%;text-indent:7.69%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Participant agrees that, due to his access to the Confidential Information, the Participant would inevitably use and/or disclose that Confidential Information in breach of his confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations if the Participant worked in certain capacities or engaged in certain activities for a period of time following his employment with the Company, specifically in a position that involves (i) responsibility and decision-making authority or input at the executive level regarding any subject or responsibility, (ii) decision-making responsibility or input at any management level in the Participant&#8217;s individual area of assignment with the Company, or (iii) responsibility and decision-making authority or input that otherwise allows the use of the Confidential Information (collectively referred to as the &#8220;Restricted Occupation&#8221;).&nbsp;&nbsp;Therefore, except with the prior written consent of the Company, during the term of this letter agreement, the Participant agrees not to be employed by, consult for or otherwise act on behalf of any person or entity in any capacity in which he would be involved, directly or indirectly, in a Restricted Occupation.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant acknowledges that this commitment is intended to protect the Confidential Information and is not intended to be applied or interpreted as a covenant against competition.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-right:7.69%;text-indent:7.69%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU9"></a>The Participant further agrees that during the term of this letter agreement, the Participant will not, directly or indirectly on behalf of a person or entity or otherwise, (i)&#160;solicit any of the established customers of the Company or attempt to induce any of the established customers of the Company to cease </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-right:7.69%;text-indent:7.69%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing in this letter agreement is intended to conflict with the Defend Trade Secrets Act or create liability for disclosures of trade secrets that are expressly allowed by that statute. In particular, under the Defend Trade Secrets Act, the Participant will not be held criminally or civilly liable under any federal or state trade secret law for the disclosure of a trade secret of the Company that is made (i) in confidence to a government official or to the Participant&#8217;s attorney solely for the purpose of reporting or investigating a suspected violation of law or (ii) in a complaint or other document that is filed under seal in a proceeding. In addition, if the Participant files a lawsuit for retaliation by the Company for reporting a suspected violation of law, the Participant may disclose the trade secret to the Participant&#8217;s attorney and use the trade secret information in the court proceeding if the Participant files any document containing the trade secret under seal and does not otherwise disclose the trade secret, except pursuant to court order. Further, nothing in this letter agreement or any other agreement or arrangement with the Company shall prohibit or restrict the Participant from making any voluntary disclosure of information or documents pertaining to violations of law to any governmental agency or legislative body, any self-regulatory organization, or the Legal Department of the Company without prior notice to the Company.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Effective <font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;">#GrantDate#</font>, you have been granted a target award of <font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;">#QuantityGranted#</font> Performance Share Units (&#8220;Award&#8221;) under the Devon Energy Corporation 2017 Long-Term Incentive Plan.&nbsp;&nbsp;Each Performance Share Unit that vests entitles you to one share of Devon Energy Corporation (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) Common Stock.&nbsp;&nbsp;The vesting of these Performance Share Units is determined pursuant to the following two-step process: (i) first, the maximum number of Performance Share Units in which you can vest shall be calculated based upon the Company&#8217;s TSR (as defined in Schedule A of the Award Agreement) over the Performance Period (as defined in the Award Agreement), (ii) then, if the value (based on the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the last day of the Performance Period) of the aggregate number of Performance Share Units calculated under clause (i) exceeds the Payout Value Limit described on Schedule A, the number of Performance Share Units calculated under clause (i) shall be reduced so that the value (based on the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the last day of the Performance Period) of the total number of vested Performance Share Units is equal to the Payout Value Limit.&nbsp;&nbsp;The maximum number of Performance Share Units that you can earn based on clause (i) during the Performance Period will be calculated as follows: <font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;">#QuantityGranted#</font> x 200%, with actual payout based on the performance level achieved by the Company with respect to the Performance Goal set forth on Schedule A.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">This Award also entitles you to be paid Dividend Equivalents as set forth in the Award Agreement.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">*<font style="color:#0070C0;">Vesting Schedule</font></p>

<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:-0.15pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU2"></a><font style="font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:-0.15pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">DEVON ENERGY CORPORATION</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:-0.15pt;font-size:12pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2017 LONG-TERM INCENTIVE PLAN</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Calibri;font-size:12pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">PERFORMANCE SHARE UNIT AGREEMENT</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">THIS PERFORMANCE SHARE UNIT AWARD AGREEMENT (this &#8220;Award Agreement&#8221;) is entered into as of <font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;">#GrantDate#</font><font style="font-weight:bold;"> </font>(the &#8220;Date of Grant&#8221;), by and between Devon Energy Corporation, a Delaware corporation (the &#8220;Company&#8221;), and <font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;">#ParticipantName#</font> (the &#8220;Participant&#8221;);</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">W I T N E S S E T H:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">WHEREAS, the Devon Energy Corporation 2017 Long-Term Incentive Plan, (the &#8220;Plan&#8221;) permits the grant of Performance Units (hereinafter referred to as &#8220;Performance Share Units&#8221;) to employees, officers and non-employee directors of the Company and its Subsidiaries and Affiliated Entities, in accordance with the terms and provisions of the Plan; and</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">WHEREAS, in connection with the Participant&#8217;s employment with the Company, the Company desires to award to the Participant<font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;"> #QuantityGranted#</font> Performance Share Units subject to the terms and conditions of this Award Agreement and the Plan; and</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">WHEREAS, the Performance Share Units granted pursuant to this Award Agreement shall vest based on the following two-step process: (i) first, the maximum number of Performance Share Units in which Participant can vest shall be calculated based on the attainment and certification of the Performance Goal described on Schedule A as of the end of the Performance Period, (ii) then, if the value (based on the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the last day of the Performance Period) of the aggregate number of Performance Share Units calculated under clause (i) exceeds the Payout Value Limit described on Schedule A, the number of Performance Share Units calculated under clause (i) shall be reduced so that the value (based on the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the last day of the Performance Period) of the total number of vested Performance Share Units is equal to the Payout Value Limit; and</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and the mutual promises and covenants herein contained, the Participant and the Company agree as follows:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1.<font style="margin-left:72pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">The Plan</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan, a copy of which is attached hereto, is hereby incorporated by reference herein and made a part hereof for all purposes, and when taken with this Award Agreement shall govern the rights of the Participant and the Company with respect to the Award.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2.<font style="margin-left:72pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Grant of Award</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company hereby grants to the Participant a target award (the &#8220;Award&#8221;) of </font><font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;font-family:Calibri;">#QuantityGranted#</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;"> Performance Share Units, on the terms and conditions set forth herein and in the Plan. </font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Calibri;"> </font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">Each Performance Share Unit that vests entitles the Participant to one share of Common Stock.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">3.<font style="margin-left:72pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Terms of Award</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(a)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Performance Share Unit Account</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company shall establish a bookkeeping account on its records for the Participant and shall credit the Participant&#8217;s Performance Share Units to the bookkeeping account.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU3"></a><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(b)</font><font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">General Vesting Terms</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;Except as provided in this Section 3, the number of Performance Share Units which actually vest under this Agreement shall be determined pursuant to the following two-step process: (i) first, the maximum number of Performance Share Units in which the Participant can vest shall be calculated based on the attainment and certification of the Performance Goal described on Schedule A as of the end of the Performance Period, (ii) then, if the value (based on the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the last day of the Performance Period) of the aggregate number of Performance Share Units calculated under clause (i) exceeds the Payout Value Limit described on Schedule A, the number of Units calculated under clause (i) shall be reduced so that the value (based on the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the last day of the Performance Period) of the total number of vested Performance Share Units is equal to the Payout Value Limit.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any Performance Share Units that do not vest under the foregoing two-step process as of the end of the Performance Period shall be forfeited as of the end of the Performance Period.&nbsp;&nbsp;Except as specifically provided below in this Section 3, in the event of a termination of the Participant&#8217;s employment prior to the end of the Performance Period, all unvested Performance Share Units will be immediately forfeited.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(c)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">If a Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination occurs by reason of disability or other special circumstances (as determined by the Committee), and the Committee determines, in its sole and absolute discretion, that the Performance Share Units shall continue to vest following the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination, the Participant shall vest in the maximum number of Performance Share Units in which the Participant could vest, based on the two-step process described in Section 3(b), as if the Participant remained in the employ of the Company through the end of the Performance Period.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(d)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">If the Participant is Post-Retirement Vesting Eligible, the Performance Share Units shall continue to vest based on the two-step process described in Section 3(b), as if the Participant remained in the employ of the Company through the end of the Performance Period, subject to satisfaction of the conditions in Section 13.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(e)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">Performance Share Units shall continue to vest and the Participant shall vest in the maximum number of Performance Share Units in which the Participant could vest, based on the two-step process described in Section 3(b), as if the Participant remained in the employ of the Company through the end of the Performance Period</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Calibri;"> </font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">following the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination that occurs under circumstances in which the Participant is entitled to a severance payment from the Company, a Subsidiary, or an Affiliated Entity under (A) the Participant&#8217;s employment agreement or severance agreement with the Company due to a termination of the Participant&#8217;s employment by the Company without &#8220;cause&#8221; or by the Participant for &#8220;good reason&#8221; in accordance with the Participant&#8217;s employment agreement or severance agreement or (B) the Devon Energy Corporation Severance Plan, provided that for a severance related termination, the Participant timely signs and returns to the Company a release of claims against the Company in a form prepared by the Company (the &#8220;Release&#8221;) and such Release becomes effective.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the Participant fails to timely sign and return the Release to the Company or revokes the Release prior to the date the Release becomes effective, the Performance Share Units (and Dividend Equivalents) subject to this Award Agreement shall be forfeited.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If (1) the Award is eligible for vesting under the circumstances described in sub-sections (d) or (e) (other than in connection with a Change in Control Event) above, and (2) the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination occurs before the one-year anniversary of the Date of Grant, then, notwithstanding such provisions in sub-sections (d) and (e) above, the number of Performance Share Units that would have otherwise vested pursuant to such provisions will be pro-rated based on the number of days from the Date of Grant to the Date of Termination out of 365.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU4"></a><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(f)</font><font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">A Participant shall become fully and immediately vested in the Award at the target level of performance for the Performance Period in the event of the Participant&#8217;s death.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(g)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Voting Rights and Dividend Equivalents</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant shall not have any voting rights with respect to the Performance Share Units.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant shall be credited with dividend equivalents (&#8220;Dividend Equivalents&#8221;) with respect to each outstanding Performance Share Unit to the extent that any dividends or other distributions (in cash or other property) are declared and/or paid with respect to the shares of Common Stock after the commencement of the Performance Period (other than distributions pursuant to a share split, for which an adjustment shall be made as described in Section 12.1 of the Plan).&nbsp;&nbsp;Dividend Equivalents shall be credited to the bookkeeping account established on the records of the Company for the Participant and will vest subject to the same conditions as are applicable to the underlying Performance Share Units, and Dividend Equivalents will be paid in cash to the Participant reasonably promptly following such vesting (but in no event later than March 15 of the calendar year following the calendar year in which such vesting occurs).&nbsp;&nbsp;Accordingly, Dividend Equivalents shall be forfeited to the extent that the Performance Share Units do not vest and are forfeited or cancelled.&nbsp;&nbsp;No interest shall be credited on Dividend Equivalents.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(h)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Conversion of Performance Share Units; Delivery of Performance Share Units</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(i)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">Except in the event of the Participant&#8217;s death or the occurrence of certain Change in Control Events as described under the Plan, the Committee shall, within a reasonably practicable time following the last day of the Performance Period, certify the extent, if any, to which the Performance Goal has been achieved with respect to the Performance Period and the number of Performance Share Units, if any, earned upon attainment of the Performance Goal, as reduced by the Payout Value Limit, if applicable.&nbsp;&nbsp;Such certification shall be final, conclusive and binding on the Participant, and on all other persons, to the maximum extent permitted by law.&nbsp;&nbsp;Payment in respect of vested Performance Share Units shall be made promptly following the Committee&#8217;s certification of the attainment of the Performance Goal and the determination of the number of vested Performance Share Units, but in any event, no later than March 15 of the year following the year in which the Performance Period ends.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">In the event of the Participant&#8217;s death, payment in respect of earned and vested Performance Share Units shall be made as soon as reasonably practicable thereafter.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(iii)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">Notwithstanding any provision of this Award Agreement to the contrary, in no event shall the timing of the Participant&#8217;s execution of the Compliance Certificate, directly or indirectly, result in the Participant designating the calendar year of payment, and if a payment that is subject to execution of the Compliance Certificate could be made in more than one taxable year, payment shall be made in the later taxable year.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(iv)<font style="margin-left:36pt;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">All payments in respect of earned and vested Performance Share Units shall be made in freely transferable shares of Common Stock.&nbsp;&nbsp;No fractional shares of Common Stock shall be issued pursuant to this Award, and any fractional share resulting from any calculation made in accordance with the terms of this Award Agreement shall be rounded down to the next whole share.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">4.<font style="margin-left:72pt;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-family:Calibri;">Employment</font><font style="font-family:Calibri;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;Nothing in the Plan or in this Award Agreement shall confer upon the Participant any right to continue in the employ of the Company or any of its Subsidiaries or Affiliated Entities, or interfere in any way with the right to terminate the Participant&#8217;s employment at any time.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>&nbsp;</p>
